name: cli-goal-progress
description: M22 A3. A long-running goal, due a check-in and re-arming every 5 minutes, is driven across two controlled sweep passes (the sweep MockClock seam) that straddle the re-armed next_checkin. Each pass fires a kind:task check-in wake; the woken agent calls update_goal to record progress, so the goal accrues two check-ins and two progress reports across the wakes. Registered as a bespoke test in tests/replay.rs (run_goal_sweep_at) — not the default trigger_sweep path.
